evaluation.design: Reliable policy evaluation is a cornerstone of robotics research [ 63 , 64 , 65 , 66 , 67 , 68 , 69 , 70 ] , with real-world deployment serving as the gold standard for assessing performance. However, real-world evaluation is costly, time-consuming, and difficult to scale, making it impractical for frequent algorithm iteration, checkpoint selection, and fair comparison across methods. As a result, there has been growing interest in developing scalable evaluation frameworks whose outcomes correlate well with real-world policy performance.
